finding.detail: FUNC_LINES 346 > 341, its value on main (over target 300: it may only go down)

rationale: The 346-line StatusRule is one cohesive status-bar view: prop destructuring, width-budget and optional-segment calculations followed by explicit JSX for each visible segment. The reviewed function has no filesystem/network calls, credential or persistence updates, effect hooks or command execution. Local tailBudget mutation only decides progressive display; its click closure delegates the supplied session-count UI callback. Keeping this exact upstream composition creates no additional branch or line growth. This disposition covers function organization/length only, not rendering, child timer correctness, terminal accessibility or whole-fork compatibility. Native and TUI runtime gates remain required.

inspection.range: StatusRule declaration through its closing brace, lines534-896; adjacent model-label/width helpers and JSX child boundaries inspected
